title: dendrobium coriaceum
intro: Dendrobium coriaceum, commonly known as the leathery dendrobium orchid, is a species of orchid native to Australia and New Guinea. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Dendrobium coriaceum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. Further research is necessary to fully understand the potential health benefits and therapeutic applications of this plant.
